title: Dependency Concordance: Quarterly Handoff Compact and Owner Summit
creator: Alyssa Chen
description:
Problem: As initiatives cross engineering, design, security, and infra, teams lose visibility into who owns the pre- and post-cutover tasks that unblock roadmap handoffs. We see repeated last-minute spikes, duplicated work, and misaligned acceptance criteria across squads.

Proposal: Create a lightweight "Concordance" artifact (machine-readable and human-friendly) plus a recurring 'Owner Summit' ritual for the quarter. The Concordance combines: a dependency ledger (who, what, when), a compact checklist for handoff readiness, and a risk tier for contingency planning. The Owner Summit is a 60-minute cross-team sync at mid-cycle for triage, re-prioritization, and re-alignment.

Goals: (1) Reduce blocked handoffs by 40% for Q2 initiatives, (2) shorten escalations that cross org boundaries by 30%, (3) ensure every high-risk dependency has a documented fallback and an owner with a verified readiness date.
acceptance_criteria: Concordance template published in Confluence with machine-parsable fields (owner, readiness_date, risk_tier, acceptance_criteria, blocker_links)
Integration demo that imports Concordance rows into the Roadmap Dashboard and shows per-initiative readiness status
First Owner Summit run for Cycle 47 with notes, action items, and owner commitments captured in-ticket
Runbook entries for three common failure modes and automated pager/escalation rules mapped to risk tiers
updates: 2026-02-08: Kickoff meeting with Eng/Design/Security/Infra leads. Decision: Concordance will be a single tabular Confluence page + CSV export. Action: Eng to prototype import spec (ENG-8421).
2026-02-18: Design reviewed initial checklist; suggested separating UX release readiness from runtime/security readiness. Added separate 'UX Acceptance' and 'Ops Acceptance' sections.

2026-02-26: Engineering spike completed. Prototype importer (internal tool) can map 'owner' and 'readiness_date' fields. Tradeoff: full automation requires minor schema changes to existing roadmap export.

2026-03-03: Security requested an approval gate for high-risk dependencies. Added 'security_signoff' boolean and 'control_mitigation' free-text field to Concordance template. Marked as non-blocking for MVP.

2026-03-09: Owner Summit scheduled for 2026-03-18; agenda drafted. Leads invited: 2 PMs, 3 Eng managers, Design lead, Infra ops lead, Security architect. Prework: each owner to publish Concordance row by 2026-03-15.
2026-03-12: Demo slot reserved for Roadmap Dashboard integration on 2026-03-17. Action: Marco to ship Confluence template and CSV spec by 2026-03-14 (PR: github.com/redwood/roadmap-tools/pull/279).
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Teams will not consistently update Concordance rows -> Mitigation: auto-reminder via Slack and Roadmap Dashboard flagging stale rows
Risk: Overhead will discourage adoption -> Mitigation: keep template to 6 fields for MVP and iterate after Owner Summit
Risk: Missing infra capacity info -> Mitigation: add 'capacity_window' and require infra ops owner to confirm by readiness_date
next_steps: Finalize Confluence template and CSV schema by 2026-03-14
Ship importer PR and internal release notes (ENG-8421)
Run Owner Summit on 2026-03-18 and capture action items
Pilot Concordance with three high-risk initiatives in Cycle 47 and measure handoff latency
